programQueue.title: Program queue
programQueue.tailDropHint: Drop here: append to program end

patternQueue.description: Phases run in order for every pattern position. Reorder by dragging; items dropped here are appended to the end of the phase list.
patternQueue.emptyPhases: Drag macros from the list here (they appear last in the list) or use “Macro here” and click a tile on the left.

queueSetup.retractZToMachineZeroOn: Machine Z retract on (program start and tool changes)
queueSetup.retractZToMachineZeroOff: Machine Z retract off (program start and tool changes)
queueSetup.retractZToMachineZeroHint: Rapids to Z0 in machine coordinates (G53 G0 Z0) at program start and again before each mid-queue tool change (different T number). Only safe when machine Z0 is at the top after homing and soft limits match. Disable if that convention does not hold.

programPathErrors.not_a_directory: The NC program directory does not exist{{pathSuffix}}. Create this folder on the controller PC, or set [DISPLAY] PROGRAM_PREFIX in your LinuxCNC INI file to an existing directory (path is relative to the INI file).
programPathErrors.outside_program_prefix: The path is outside the NC program directory configured as [DISPLAY] PROGRAM_PREFIX in the LinuxCNC INI{{pathSuffix}}.
programPathErrors.file_not_found: The file does not exist or cannot be read{{pathSuffix}}.
programPathErrors.parent_not_found: The parent folder does not exist{{pathSuffix}}. Create it or choose another save location.
programPathErrors.is_directory: Cannot save here{{pathSuffix}}: the path is a folder, not a file.
programPathErrors.generateProgramListFailed: Could not access the NC program directory to save the generated program.
programPathErrors.generateProgramListInvalidResponse: Could not determine the NC program directory (unexpected response from the controller).
programPathErrors.generateProgramSaveFailed: Could not save the generated program.
programPathErrors.notConnected: Not connected — connect to the backend first.
programPathErrors.alreadyGenerating: A program is already being generated. Please wait.
programPathErrors.openProgramFailed: Could not load the program in LinuxCNC.
programPathErrors.readProgramFailed: Could not read the program file from the controller.

toolChange.body: Please load or change tool T{{toolNo}} and confirm when done.

unhomedJog.title: Axis not homed
unhomedJog.paragraph1: No homing (reference) has been performed for the selected axis{{suffix}}.
unhomedJog.paragraph2: Jogging this axis now uses joint mode: individual motors move directly. Please confirm you want to continue.

touchNumeric.invalidExpression: Invalid expression. Check the input (e.g. 5-3 or 10+0.5).
touchNumeric.emptyRequired: Please enter a value or cancel.

update.title: plasmaweb {{version}} is available
update.restartNote: The update installs while plasmaweb keeps running. Restart LinuxCNC afterwards to use the new version.
update.notPermitted: This install cannot update itself. On the controller, run once: sudo /opt/plasmaweb/install.sh --setup-update
update.installing: Installing — do not restart LinuxCNC until this finishes.
update.installedBody: plasmaweb {{version}} is installed. Restart LinuxCNC to use it.
update.failedBody: Nothing was changed if the download or checksum failed. The output below says where it stopped.
